routing_guidelines.description: Fortegra customer complaint triage and response routing guidelines

immediate_supervisor_escalation: customer explicitly requests supervisor or manager
customer threatens legal action or attorney involvement
customer threatens regulatory complaint (DOI, CFPB, BBB)
customer expresses intent to cancel or has already cancelled
complaint references media or social media threats
legal_review_required: customer has retained or is consulting an attorney
regulatory_flag_required: customer states intent to file DOI complaint
complaint involves a denied claim above $10000
complaint involves a vulnerable customer (elderly, disability mentioned)
second complaint from same customer within 90 days

urgency_levels.critical: Requires response within 4 business hours. Supervisor involvement mandatory.
urgency_levels.high: Requires response within 24 business hours. Supervisor review recommended.
urgency_levels.standard: Requires response within 3 business days. Standard adjuster handling.
urgency_levels.low: Requires response within 5 business days. Standard adjuster handling.

response_tone_guidelines.furious_or_very_upset: Acknowledge frustration immediately and specifically. Do not be defensive. Commit to specific next steps with timeframes. Avoid policy language in opening.
response_tone_guidelines.upset_or_frustrated: Empathize before explaining. Summarize their concern back to them before responding. Offer clear path to resolution.
response_tone_guidelines.disappointed_or_neutral: Professional and clear. Explain the situation factually. Offer next steps.
